**ID:** T2761
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 寶積部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous Dūnhuáng manuscript fragment is a commentary on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)* (T0353). Preserved in Taishō volume 85 — the *Dūnhuáng yíshū* 敦煌遺書 series.

**Abstract**

The work is anonymous and undated; conventional scholarship places it in the broad Tang period (600 – 900 CE) of Dūnhuáng manuscript production.

The Taishō text (T2761) is established on the Dūnhuáng manuscript witness.
